# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 53 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 40 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_053_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 53

**1** His disciples said to him: "Does circumcision help you or not?"

**2** He said: "If it helped, babies would come out of their mothers already circumcised. But circumcision of the spirit — that is what truly counts."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "Help you" — the practical framing
- "Babies would come out already circumcised" — vivid, direct
- "That is what truly counts" — "found complete usefulness" rendered as what matters
